caseName: Bruce's Juices, Inc. v. American Can Co.
caseNameFull: Bruce's Juices, Inc. v. American Can Co.
attorneys: Cody Fowler, R. W. Shackleford and Thurman Arnold for petitioner. Wright Patman filed a memorandum as amicus curiae, in support, of petitioner.

opinions.text: The petition for rehearing in this case is granted and the case is restored to the docket for reargument before a full bench. The motion to withhold issuance of the mandate is also granted.
